notes.title: The Weighted Impostor
notes.description: Three identical cream boxes conceal two solid wooden blocks and a hollow glass box with a glued weight: the weighted box weighs 0.51694 kg, about 55% more than either 0.3328 kg wooden block. Lift all three to identify the heaviest, then probe its friction; an impulse of approximately 1.254 N·s stops it at 0.75 m.
notes.prompt: find the heaviest of three identical boxes, where one hollow box hides a glued weight among solid wooden blocks
